---
title: Number formatting
---

`lt_format()` controls decimals (`decimals`) or significant digits (`sig_digits`), the thousands mark (`big_mark`), percent, and a `prefix` or `suffix`.

```{r}
library(lt)
d = data.frame(
  Item = c("Widget", "Gadget", "Doohickey"),
  Revenue = c(1234567.891, 987654.321, 246913.57),
  Margin = c(0.1234, 0.0567, 0.2345),
  Mass = c(123456.7, 98765.43, 1234.567),
  Weight = c(1250, 340.5, 89.12)
)
lt(d) |> lt_format(~ Revenue, decimals = 0, big_mark = ",", prefix = "$")
lt(d) |> lt_format(~ Margin, decimals = 1, percent = TRUE)
lt(d) |> lt_format(~ Mass, sig_digits = 3)
lt(d) |> lt_format(~ Weight, decimals = 1, suffix = " kg")
```
